sample.input_source: all three conservative parse archives, exact nominal accusative/dative/locative and root-final low BB/BF/FB/FF fragment
sample.rule: Keep all intended roots and observations in input and coverage inventories. Score only interpretable observations; no fabricated label or pseudocount is assigned to unresolved observations. All models use identical scored rows.
sample.side_observed_target_roots: Report as a separate availability stratum, not the only primary sample.
sample.manual_exclusions: retain source manual flags; no primary deletion based on them
sample.unrounded_sensitivity: input-defined all harmonic root vowels are a/e; same analysis scheme

partition.strata: BB/BF/FB/FF template crossed with input-defined unrounded status
partition.ordering: SHA256 of seed, stratum and root separated by NUL; round-robin within stratum with deterministic stratum offset
partition.rule: All target observations of each outer root remain together. Every inner map contains only the corresponding outer-training roots. No outcomes enter partition generation.

information.primary: side-informed root transfer: test accusative counts may set its baseline; target dative/locative outcomes are withheld
information.secondary: wholly unseen root: all test side and target observations withheld; training prior and root structure only
information.shared: All models receive the same reference features, side information and transformations. Hyperparameters, HU estimation, cost offsets and regularization use the corresponding training block only.
information.HU: Same source full-interaction binomial-logit random-intercept architecture, now with explicitly declared proper Gaussian regularization of all original eleven fixed-effect coefficients, fitted within each block. Fixed-effects-only predictions for both training grammar features and withheld roots; no fitted conditional root intercept enters features.
information.source_scope: This tests generalization when held-out harmonic paradigms are unavailable. It is not a claim about the published model's fit when the same root's harmonic outputs are available. The released published analysis remains separately reconstructed.

general_retention_boundary: A=0,B>0 is a limiting law, not an attained finite H,lambda grammar. A=B=0 leaves lambda unidentified. A>0 permits lambda=B/A. Report boundary behavior explicitly.
raising_baseline: Within each corresponding training block, separately for final a/e, form the proper beta-binomial hyperposterior in mu and r=1/(1+c). Fixed independent priors mu~Beta(1/2,1/2), r~Beta(1,1) for the primary analysis. Set mu_hat=E[mu|training side counts], r_hat=E[r|training side counts], c_hat=(1-r_hat)/r_hat, alpha=mu_hat*c_hat, beta=(1-mu_hat)*c_hat. Then use exactly the existing plug-in rho=(k+alpha)/(n+alpha+beta), d=log((1-rho)/rho). This is an explicitly declared point-summary working baseline, not the full posterior predictive mixture.
control_sensitivity: Two additive suffix offsets estimated from training BB/FF raising counts ONLY; freeze before BF/FB predictions; same offsets for all comparators; count two added nuisance choices. Use fixed ridge 0.0001 if separation prevents a finite estimate, disclose its use.

grammar_fitting.objective: Mean per-incidence multinomial negative log likelihood plus alpha/2 times squared Euclidean norm in declared native nonnegative coordinates
grammar_fitting.selection: Maximize inner root-balanced mean log density. Differences within 1e-8 select the larger alpha.
grammar_fitting.penalty_scope: Regularization depends on coordinates; it is not a representation-invariant theory-economy measure. Report the unregularized sensitivity where a finite checked fit exists.
grammar_fitting.checks: Analytic gradients, independent finite differences and nonnegative-cone projected KKT; actual tolerances frozen in the validated executable, not relaxed after comparative outcomes.

evaluation.primary: Root-balanced out-of-fold mean joint log predictive density
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap of per-root out-of-fold score differences, 5000 replicates, seed 2026092007; intervals conditional on fitted folds/models. This does not establish independence of incidences, articles or speakers, nor include full refitting uncertainty.
evaluation.multiple_comparisons: Report the complete prespecified comparison table. No selective model/fold reporting or nominal iid-token significance claims.
evaluation.claim_rule: A relative score advantage alone is not confirmation of input memory. Interpret the joint restrictions, transfer controls, representational alternatives and lexical extension together. Negative or inconclusive outcomes remain visible.

nuisance_prior_sensitivity.scope: Repeat the same complete prespecified comparison into separate outputs; never select the prior by target likelihood or model ranking. The prior is an observation-model assumption common to all six grammars, not a phonological parameter or uniquely objective choice.

HU_estimator.type: Penalized marginal-likelihood point estimate / Gaussian-prior MAP approximation; not published unregularized glmer ML and not full Bayesian posterior prediction
HU_estimator.penalty: sum(beta_j^2)/(2*tau^2), including intercept, in the eleven original source-formula coordinates. Add to the sum (not mean) negative marginal log likelihood. Log frequency remains standardized by the corresponding training block; rho remains on its original0–1 scale.
HU_estimator.rationale: Exact separation prevents a finite unregularized estimate in an actual required training partition. Proper regularization supplies a finite, explicitly assumption-dependent estimator. Both fixed scales are broad relative to unit-logit changes and permit nearly deterministic class predictions; neither is claimed uniquely objective or learned from held-out outcomes. Their effect is reported, not selected for a favorable mechanism ranking.
HU_estimator.all_blocks: Use the same estimator on every training block, in both HU_plus_surface and retention_bounded_plus_HU. Do not regularize only failed folds.
HU_estimator.rank: Fit all eleven native coefficients. Report data-design rank/constant/dependent columns as diagnostics; do not drop dependent columns and then silently impose a different Gaussian prior. Zero-information coefficients are controlled by the declared prior.
HU_estimator.variance: Keep the pre-existing log_sigma bounds[-8,log20] for numerical search and the original gate rejecting a fit at either bound. No new sigma prior or phonological restriction is asserted.
HU_estimator.optimization: Same three sigma starts .1,.5,2, genuine optimizer and second-order convergence, original residual/FD/PG/multistart criteria. Differentiate the penalized objective; separately retain data likelihood, penalty, and unpenalized gradient diagnostics.
HU_estimator.complexity: All11 regression coefficients plus random-effect variance belong to the shared HU observation layer. Tau is a declared fixed regularization assumption, not a fitted phonological parameter. Data-design rank and native prior geometry are distinct; no representation-invariant economy claim.
HU_estimator.sensitivity_runs: Cross tau20/50 with both already frozen raising-baseline priors. Four complete isolated comparison outputs; non-HU models must be identical across tau for a fixed baseline prior. No new outcome/fold/model selection rule.

study_type: Retrospective corpus-based comparison, with outcome-blind root partitions and nested training-only information policies.

baseline_numerics.method: Tensor Gauss-Jacobi quadrature with exact beta-prior weights and log-sum-exp likelihood normalization; orders32,64,128,256,512,1024. Stop on required mean/shape/log-evidence refinement agreement; retain diagnostics. No optimizer bound is reclassified as a successful MLE.
baseline_numerics.gate: Positive finite alpha/beta and interior posterior means; refinement mean changes<=1e-7, shape relative changes<=1e-4, log-evidence change<=1e-5. Unmet convergence blocks the comparison.
